answer: Every agent runs inside an enclave whose fused key the forge signed at manufacture, and the ridge records each key once it backs an identity, so no chip backs two. The ridge links identities whose chips were bought with funds meeting within three hops. An operator's k-th linked agent must present k fresh chips, each sold by the forge for 40 yarrow. A lone agent spends 40 yarrow; 100 clones need 5,050 chips, 202,000 yarrow of unrentable silicon, or unrelated buyers paid to surrender their own.
